pypi.measurement: Artifact requests with filenames ending .whl, .tar.gz or .zip; not unique users, installs or retention.
pypi.measurement_change_handling: Apply the same artifact-only filter throughout history; retain logged_objects and excluded_requests in raw records and verify their arithmetic. This reduces the documented metadata-counting break but does not certify invariant download behavior.

pypi_releases.measurement: One event per retained visible package version at its earliest artifact upload time; multiple wheel/sdist files are not multiple releases.
pypi_releases.limitation: Retrospective currently/previously retained visible artifacts can omit deleted history; no claim of a real-time metadata vintage.

gharchive.measurement: Observed captured public GitHub events and distinct captured event actors. A captured zero is not proof of zero repository activity. PushEvents are not commit counts.
gharchive.policy: Exclude every GH numeric feature, including missingness flags, from primary modeling for all dates. Preserve observed_gh_* series for diagnostics. Mask gh_* event/actor features in any day/week overlapping known degradation. Earlier capture remains unvalidated, not certified complete.
gharchive.retrieval_is_not_capture: Successful queries, nonempty global tables, date coverage, checksums and zero missing event IDs validate retrieval only. They cannot establish upstream capture completeness.
gharchive.correction: No corrected counts or inverse-global-volume scaling are estimated. Independent repository/date/type capture validation is required before re-enabling GH predictors.
gharchive.evidence_scope: Firsthand source-project issue reports and operators document capture loss; these are not certified missingness fractions for our cohort. The May 24 boundary is the first known multi-event degradation, not a guarantee for earlier dates. OpenDigger history beginning September 6, 2026 cannot repair the January-August holdout.

arxiv.measurement: Current revised paper metadata and unreviewed tool-paper candidate matches.
arxiv.limitation: No historical first-seen vintages or reviewed match labels; excluded from historical forecasts.

missingness.pre_artifact: Downloads and release counts before the first retained visible artifact remain NaN, never zero. A partial first week remains NaN.
missingness.warmup: Rolling/lagged features need their stated prior full weeks. Future labels need eight full outcome weeks plus the availability lag. Expected warmup and not-yet-mature labels are not missing source retrieval.
